headline: Revenue and margins accelerate sharply across the board
summary_short: Revenue of $1.674B was up 31.5% q/q and 37.7% y/y; diluted EPS of $2.81 rose 91.2% q/q and 37.7% y/y.
summary_long: Revenue reached $1.674B, up 31.5% q/q and 37.7% y/y. Gross margin expanded to 93.7% (+194bp q/q, +21bp y/y) and net margin rose to 35.0% (+1,115bp q/q, +166bp y/y). Operating income of $700M rose 132.6% q/q and 32.1% y/y. Diluted EPS of $2.81 increased 91.2% q/q and 37.7% y/y, in line with net income growth of 93.1% q/q and 44.6% y/y.
